value: Experience the ultimate personal wellness retreat with this 1-person infrared sauna, built for a single-person footprint in Canadian Hemlock. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features advanced carbon and near-infrared heating technology for deep, even heat distribution. Enjoy chromotherapy lighting, red light therapy, and a Himalayan salt bar for enhanced health benefits. The space-saving design fits seamlessly into any indoor setting, while the Bluetooth audio system and touch screen controls provide a modern, user-friendly experience. Easy to assemble with clasp-together construction, this sauna operates efficiently on a standard 120V outlet, making it an ideal addition to your wellness routine.
